subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a permanent plugin SDK API for profile-specific provider quota reads?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin API crossing credential and provider ownership boundaries; code review can assess implementation safety, but maintainers must choose whether this capability belongs in the supported long-term SDK contract.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the exact-profile, token-free read API with its fail-closed scope rules, documentation, and compatibility expectations, then require live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep quota access internal
options.body: Do not publish this plugin API; retain provider usage access behind existing core-owned surfaces and close or substantially narrow the PR.

options.title: Request an alternative seam
options.body: Define a narrower owner-approved plugin capability before accepting provider-profile usage access in the public runtime.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the exact-profile, token-free read API with its fail-closed scope rules, documentation, and compatibility expectations, then require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor owns the current proposal and can incorporate an approved contract direction, while final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
